newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gold rates seen easing this week.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gold rates seen easing this week.

text.p: Pakistan gold rates are likely to ease in the week starting Monday as the precious metal's price fell on the international markets, dealers said.
"Gold rates are expected to fall below 6,100 per tola after a drop of at least $20 per ounce on the international markets," dealer Jan Mohammad of ARY Traders said.
The gold rate for 24 karat in Karachi in rupees per 10 grammes Sunday, November 24 5,225 5,306. Silver rate in Karachi per 1,000 grammes 7,286 7,286 ($1 = 40.22 rupees).
